I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands on **Nov 3, 2025**.

That date comes from Moss's Coastal digest of Sunday, Nov 2, 2025. It says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03."

The digest doesn't say Kwame is the new owner, so I told her to confirm that before it goes in the tracker. I also warned her that "PHL" is shorthand for both Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Covey & Lark Retail (now Pellow Home Living). The Saltmarsh handoff on Oct 6, 2025 is a different account, so it shouldn't be mixed in.
